approval_text: Proceed, please, I agree with your recommendation.
scope: Common owner/session/provision/receipt interfaces, existing thread and isolated worktree, after independent codec acceptance and subject to all existing dependencies and acceptance gates.
conditions: Same unchanged accepted Go binary, real Rust owner transactions, restricted SDK, cancellation, durable Result/Receipt, existing authenticated Execution API readback and process/descendant/source cleanup.

Crash recovery and uncertain commit/spawn/lost-ACK handling without replay or ownership reassignment.
restrictions: Python-owned executions unchanged; production dispatch disabled.
No production, merge, deployment, expanded credential authority, profile freeze, additional agents or renewal approval.
Green conformance is not runtime acceptance. No runtime or lifecycle goal completion until required evidence is accepted.
note: Source reconciliation is a local Git merge into the isolated spike branch, not a pull-request merge, deployment or runtime acceptance.
